definitions.missingPayloads: [DecidableEq Payload] → (dictionary : List Payload) → (entries : List (Key × Payload)) → List Payload := ((entries.map Prod.snd).filter (fun payload => decide (payload ∉ dictionary))).dedup
definitions.appendEntries: dictionary := expandedDictionary original.dictionary entries; Packed := ⟨dictionary, original.references ++ entries.map (fun entry => (entry.1, dictionary.idxOf entry.2))⟩

theorems.mem_missingPayloads_iff: payload ∈ missingPayloads dictionary entries ↔ payload ∈ entries.map Prod.snd ∧ payload ∉ dictionary
theorems.payload_mem_expandedDictionary: entry ∈ entries → entry.2 ∈ expandedDictionary dictionary entries
theorems.appendEntries_keys: (appendEntries original entries).references.map Prod.fst = original.references.map Prod.fst ++ entries.map Prod.fst
theorems.agreement_of_valid: Valid original → AgreesOnReferences original.dictionary (expandedDictionary original.dictionary entries) original.references
theorems.unpack_original_references: Valid original → unpack (replaceDictionary original (expandedDictionary original.dictionary entries)) = unpack original
theorems.unpack_appendEntries: Valid original → unpack (appendEntries original entries) = (unpack original).map (fun rows => rows ++ entries)
theorems.unpack_appendEntries_pack: unpack (appendEntries (pack oldRows) entries) = some (oldRows ++ entries), using actual unpack_pack
theorems.missing_validity_counterexample: Original Packed Nat Nat = ⟨[],[(11,0)]⟩ is invalid and decodes none; entries [(12,7)] fill slot zero. Reusing original refs decodes [(11,7)], full appendEntries decodes [(11,7),(12,7)], violating old optional-map equation without Valid.
